createsolar.ponder.sculk_panel.text_1: Sculk Panels generate Experience from moonlight at night. They work opposite to solar panels and are only active between moonrise and moonset.
createsolar.ponder.sculk_panel.text_2: The moon phase affects how much XP you get. A full moon gives the most, while a new moon gives the least.
createsolar.ponder.sculk_panel.text_3: The panel gives a redstone signal matching its stored XP, from 0 (empty) to 15 (full).
createsolar.ponder.sculk_panel.text_4: Right-click any connected panel to collect all stored Experience at once.
createsolar.ponder.sculk_panel.text_5: Sculk panels placed next to each other share their XP storage, just like solar panels share energy.
createsolar.ponder.solar_panel.text_1: Solar Panels turn sunlight into Forge Energy during the day. Output rises from sunrise, peaks at midday, and fades toward sunset.
createsolar.ponder.solar_panel.text_2: The panel needs a clear view of the sky. Any block above lowers its output. Rain cuts it by half, and thunderstorms stop it completely.
createsolar.ponder.solar_panel.text_3: Energy comes out of the bottom of the panel. Connect a cable or place an Accumulator nearby to store the power.
createsolar.ponder.solar_panel.text_4: The panel gives a redstone signal matching its stored energy, from 0 (empty) to 15 (full). Useful for monitoring and automation.
createsolar.ponder.solar_panel.text_5: Solar panels placed next to each other share one energy buffer. The total storage gets bigger with more panels.
